Living (or once living) individuals of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series who exist in the "real world" of [[Randland]]. This does not include true real-world people such as [[:Category:Creators|Creators]].

All characters in the series can be classified in five different ways. 

#''' By Sex''' - [[:Category:Men|Men]], [[:Category:Women|Women]] and, rarely, [[:Category:Unknown gender|Unknown gender]].
# '''By Status''' - [[:Category:Living|Alive]], [[:Category:Deceased|Dead]] and, occasionally, [[:Category:Unknown status|Unknown status]]
# '''By Occupation''' - This can be further split up into two main subgroups - those of [[:Category:Channelers|Channelers]] and those that mainly concern [[:Category:Occupations|Non-channelers]].
# '''By Origin''' - This will be the nationality and/or ethnic group. For many characters, however, their origins are [[:Category:Unknown nationality|unknown]].
# '''By Species''' - While the vast majority of characters mentioned are human, there are also many named [[:Category:Non-humans|Non-humans]]. 

This method of categorization is derived mainly from the use of the [[Template:Character|Character template]], which should be included in all entries on the characters. This is a work-in-progress, so some characters may be missing from the character lists in the main sections, though will have entries in the wiki.
